resolution: Restructured the Studio persistence to the user's branch/twig law (saved to memory feedback_studio_branch_twig_cold_hot). The req_0993 shortcut made the live scene the persisted stream so it auto-restored on cold start — wrong. Now: cold start boots to 'new' (blank); branch = persisted + undoable per-model (every mesh edit); twig = working-state (camera/tool/selection/which-model-open), hot-reload-only, never undone, reset cold. Mechanism: hotstate.zig is in-process (survives V8 re-eval, cleared on restart), so the open-model twig lives there via new imperative getHotState/setHotState in runtime/hooks. modelStream is now a LIBRARY of saved models (each {id,name,parts,order}, events scoped to their model id — the map-editor mapName idiom); studioModel is a working scene over one open model, boots 'new', auto-creates+names a model (new_mesh_NNN) on first add, branch-scoped undo. The workbench roster (model/source.tsx) is the library: a '+ new' row + saved models, onPick opens; a new shell hook selectedRow() makes the highlight follow the store (so the roster reads 'new' on cold start, not the disk twig). Rename via the MODEL panel name field. Crash fix (req_1001): the old flat-parts snapshot shape made selectors read undefined.models on boot — the reducer + selectors now normalize/guard, discarding the pre-req_0998 shape (boot-to-new wants those throwaway cubes gone). Tests: modelStream 6/6 (round-trip, per-model isolation, order, passthrough, inverse, old-shape tolerance), editMesh 25/25, full sources.ts chain + shell bundle clean. Hot-reload TSX, nothing committed. Deferred (twig other half): camera/tool/selection survive hot reload — still useState, reset on hot reload for now; the open-model already survives.
